blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications. However, this requires reconstructing each frame in real time, transmitting the data within strict bandwidth budgets, and decoding it on lightweight client GPUs. Existing approaches, whether relying on per-frame optimization or feed-forward inference, generate massive 3D Gaussian payloads that exceed practical streaming limits, while aggressive compression severely degrades rendering quality. In this work, we present HoloSplat, a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video. HoloSplat splits a feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head, introducing a multi-rate streaming codec driven by server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server side, we apply opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding for token anchors. On the client side, a feature reconstruction hypernetwork is fused into the Gaussian head to recover compression-induced quality loss. Furthermore, we introduce Neural Session Calibration (NSC), which rapidly fine-tunes the Gaussian head online using incoming camera views during a warm-up phase. This resolves quality degradation from novel camera parameters and varying capture conditions with zero per-frame overhead. In our evaluations, HoloSplat averages 32.2 FPS on four RTX 5090 GPUs at 50 Mbit/s. It decodes each frame into 3D Gaussians in 22.1 ms on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop GPU, transmitting 22.8$\times$ less data than uncompressed float32 Gaussians, while calibrated decoding improves PSNR by 1.050 dB.
blocks.zh: 人类的直播自由视点视频流可以实现浸泡式远程存在和交互XR应用. 然而,这需要实时重建每个帧,在严格的带宽预算范围内传输数据,并在轻量级客户端GPU上解码. 现有的方法,无论是依靠每帧优化还是饲料推论,生成超过实际流线限制的大规模3D高斯有效载荷,而积极的压缩则严重降低渲染质量. 在这部作品中,我们呈现了HoloSplat,一个以人为中心的量子视频的实时流线框架. HoloSplat在它的高斯头之前将一个向导的重建器分割开来,引入了由服务器边的符号压缩和客户端边的符号修复驱动的多速率流代码. 在服务器方面,我们采用不透明制导的代号推算法,基于PCA的维度减值法,以及无损几何编码的代号主锚法. 在客户端,一个功能重建超网络被连接到高斯头,以恢复压缩引起的质量损失. 此外,我们引入了神经会话校准(NSC),它利用热身阶段的摄像头对高斯人的头进行快速微调。 这解决了新式相机参数的质量退化问题,并解决了每帧零的捕获条件。 在我们的评价中,HoloSplate平均在4个RTX 5090 GPU上以50 Mbit/s的速度得到32.2 FPS. 它在一台RTX 3050 Ti笔记本电脑GPU上将每个帧解码为22.1 mss的3D Gaussians,传输的数据比未压缩的浮标32 Gaussians少22.8$\times$,而校准的解码则以1.050 dB改进了PSNR.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications, allowing viewers to render arbitrary viewpoints in real time. At 30 FPS, three stages in series must meet strict per-frame budgets ( Fig. 2 ). Specifically, the server must reconstruct each frame in real time (every 33 ms with bounded delay), the network must transmit each frame within practical bandwidth budgets such as a 100 Mbit/s 5G downlink [ 25 ] , and a lightweight client must decode each frame into renderable 3D Gaussians [ 33 ] in 33 ms.
blocks.zh: 活式自由取景视频流载人类,可以使浸入式远程存在和交互XR应用,使观众能够实时地提出任意的观点. 在30 FPS中,系列的三个阶段必须严格满足每个框架的预算(图2)。 具体来说,服务器必须实时重建每个帧(每33 ms带有被捆绑的延迟),网络必须在实际带宽预算范围内传输每个帧,如100 Mbit/s 5G下行链路[25],一个轻量级客户端必须在33 ms中将每个帧解码为可渲染的3D Gaussians[33].

blocks.en: However, whether reconstructed via per-frame optimisation or feed-forward inference, each frame generates heavy 3D Gaussian payloads that exceed practical streaming bandwidth, while aggressive compression degrades rendering quality ( Fig. 2 ). Per-frame optimisation methods [ 65 , 16 , 17 , 83 , 34 ] render in real time on the client [ 17 , 31 ] , but fitting frame t t from frame t − 1 t{-}1 turns server reconstruction into a sequential optimisation taking 1.2–23.4 s per frame that cannot be parallelised across GPUs, at ≥ {\geq} 154 Mbit/s [ 65 , 16 , 17 ] . Feed-forward inference [ 93 , 21 , 70 ] reconstructs each frame in one pass, yet still emits dense 3D Gaussians ( ≥ {\geq} 173 Mbit/s with 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) compression methods [ 51 , 7 ] ) or loses quality under aggressive video coding [ 70 ] . In alternative paradigms, the bottleneck merely shifts ( Sec. 2 ). Static-scene feature codecs [ 87 ] cause client overload (199 ms), multi-view video streams duplicate reconstruction on every client (85–126 ms), server-rendered video ties viewpoint changes to a network round trip, and person-specific avatars [ 44 , 40 ] need 2 days of training.

blocks.en: We present HoloSplat, a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video that splits a frame-parallel feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head, streaming compressed tokens from the server while the client restores tokens and runs the head to generate 3D Gaussians. Existing 3DGS streaming methods compress explicit Gaussians after the head, where non-linear activations—particularly exponential scaling—map compact, correlated tokens into an expanded attribute space in which small quantisation errors amplify rendering distortion by four orders of magnitude ( Sec. 4.3 ). Compressing pre-head tokens instead of post-head attributes achieves high compression ratios with minimal quality loss; although each 1024-dimensional token in PointSplat [ 21 ] has more dimensions than the 224 attributes of its 16 Gaussians, the same codec outperforms post-head attribute compression by 2.8–10.3 dB.
blocks.zh: 我们提出"HoloSplatz"(HoloSplatz),即以人为中心的量子视频的实时流线框架,在高斯头之前分出一个帧相平行的向导重建器,从服务器上流出被压缩的活字,同时客户端恢复活字并运行活字头来生成3D高斯头. 现有的3DGS流线法在头后压缩出明显的高斯人,即非线性活化——特别是指数缩放-映射紧凑,将相联的活化为扩大的属性空间,其中小的量化错误将渲染扭曲放大了四个数量级(第4.3节)。 压缩前头符号而不是后头属性,在质量损失最小的情况下实现高压缩比;虽然PointSplatz [21]中的每个1024维符号的尺寸比其16个高斯人中的224个属性要多,但同名编码器的后头属性压缩比2.8-10.3 dB的功率要高.

blocks.en: Building on this split, we design a multi-rate streaming codec consisting of server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server, we perform opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based token dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding of token anchor coordinates. On the client, we design a FiLM-conditioned feature reconstruction hypernetwork to recover the quality lost to compression, and fuse both inverse PCA and the hypernetwork into the client Gaussian head. Leveraging kept PCA coefficients, local anchor geometry, and spatial neighbours, the hypernetwork and its one-time update recover 80.4% of the compression loss at zero per-frame bitrate overhead, without explicit 1024-dimensional token expansion.
blocks.zh: 在这个分拆的基础上,我们设计出由服务器侧式符号压缩和客户端侧式符号修复组成的多速分流代码. 在服务器上,我们执行不透明制导的代号搜索,基于PCA的代号维度降低,以及代号锚地坐标的无损几何编码. 在客户端上,我们设计了一个 FiLM 条件化的功能重建超网络 以恢复压缩损失的质量, 并且将反向PCA和超网络 连接到客户端高斯的头部。 Leveraging保持了PCA系数,本地锚地几何,以及空间相邻,超网络及其一次性更新,以每帧比特率零的高度回收了压缩损失的80.4%,没有明确的1024维符号扩展.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we introduce neural session calibration (NSC), which rapidly fine-tunes the Gaussian head online during the warm-up stage using incoming camera views, resolving the quality loss of the Gaussian head caused by new camera parameters and varying capture conditions at zero per-frame overhead. On HiFi4G [ 27 ] and ActorsHQ [ 24 ] , before calibration, removing token compression changes PSNR by at most 0.13 dB ( Figs. 4 and S37 ), confirming that this quality loss occurs even without compression rather than from codec distortion; NSC fits a compact 44.5 kB low-rank update on the first second of the eight input views and fuses it into the client Gaussian head before streaming.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们引入神经会话校正(NSC),在暖暖阶段迅速对高斯人头进行在线微调,利用即将到来的相机取景,解决了高斯人头因新相机参数造成的质量损失,以及每帧高斯人头的捕捉条件不一而足。 在HiFi4G [27]和ActorsHQ [24]上,在校正前,去除符号压缩变化PSNR最多以0.13 dB(图4和S37)来进行,确认这种质量损失即使没有被压缩而不是由代码扭曲而发生;NSC在8个输入视图的第一秒上符合了紧凑的44.5 kB低档更新,并在流出前将其导入客户高斯人头.

blocks.en: HoloSplat meets all three budgets ( Fig. 2 , bottom). It averages 32.2 FPS on four RTX 5090 GPUs at 50 Mbit/s for the Pro tier and decodes each frame into 3D Gaussians in 22.1 ms on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop GPU, with five GPUs streaming live at 30 FPS over Wi-Fi at 204–304 ms end-to-end latency. Pro transmits 22.8 × \times less data than float32 Gaussians while calibrated decoding improves PSNR by 1.050 dB, and saves 67–85% in bitrate over 3DGS compression methods at equal quality. From the same eight views, all three tiers outperform HiCoM, QUEEN, and 3DGStream in quality and bitrate on every sequence at 16 × \times the speed—with Pro outperforming offline 4C4D [ 97 ] by 1.62 dB at 58 × \times lower payload size—while NSC adds +1.154 dB on DNA-Rendering [ 8 ] and +1.419 and +1.436 dB on unseen rigs.
blocks.zh: HoloSplact满足所有三个预算(图2,下). 它平均在4个RTX 5090 GPU上以50 Mbit/s对Pro级进行32.2 FPS,并在一台RTX 3050 Ti膝上型GPU上以22.1 ms将每个帧解码为3D Gaussians,5个GPU在Wi-Fi上以30 FPS进行流线直播,时速为204–304 ms端到端间闲置. Pro传输的数据为22.8×\times 少于浮点32高斯人,而校正解码则以1.050分贝改进了PSNR,并以等质的比特率节省了67-85%的比特率超过3DGS压缩方法. 从同样的八种观点来看,所有三个层次的质量都超过了HiCoM、QUEEN和3DGStream,在16 × 时,速度——在58 × 分时,Pro优于线下4C4D [97],1.62分贝,负载尺寸更低——而NSC则在DNA-渲染[8]和+1.419和+1.436分贝上增加了+1.154分贝。

blocks.en: 1. Multi-rate token streaming codec. We design a multi-rate streaming codec for human-centric volumetric video consisting of server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server, we perform opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based token dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding of token anchor coordinates, transmitting 22.8 × \times less data than float32 Gaussians and, with our client decoder, saving 67–85% in bitrate over 3DGS compression methods at equal quality. 2. Feature reconstruction hypernetwork and fused decoding. On the client, we design a feature reconstruction hypernetwork that leverages kept PCA coefficients, local anchor geometry, and spatial neighbours—recovering 80.4% of the quality lost to compression with its one-time update—and fuse inverse PCA and the hypernetwork into the Gaussian head to decode in 22.1 ms on a laptop GPU, enabling the full system to beat per-frame optimisation methods in quality, bitrate, and speed. 3. Neural session calibration. During the warm-up stage, we rapidly fine-tune the Gaussian head online using incoming camera views (44.5 kB low-rank update fused into the client head at zero per-frame overhead), resolving the quality loss of the Gaussian head caused by new camera parameters and varying capture conditions.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
3DGStream [ 65 ] trains a per-frame transformation cache, while HiCoM [ 16 ] and QUEEN [ 17 ] accelerate per-frame optimisation with hierarchical motion and quantised residuals; ReCon-GS [ 15 ] adapts a motion hierarchy, ComGS [ 3 ] updates only motion-sensitive keypoints, and iFVC [ 67 ] entropy-codes a binary transformation cache.
Instant Gaussian Stream [ 83 ] predicts motion with a generalisable network but still refines key frames, MoRGS [ 34 ] regularises per-Gaussian motion with optical flow on key views, 4DGC [ 23 ] optimises motion grids for rate and distortion, and StreamSTGS [ 31 ] encodes canonical attributes as images and temporal features as video.
V 3 [ 75 ] , VideoRF [ 74 ] , and TeTriRF [ 78 ] pack attributes or features into 2D maps for video codecs, and ReRF [ 73 ] codes residual radiance fields.
Human-centric systems such as HiFi4G [ 27 ] and DualGS [ 26 ] track a performer and compress the resulting 4D Gaussians, SharpTimeGS [ 41 ] modulates Gaussian lifespans, and NeuS2 [ 77 ] fine-tunes a hash-encoded surface from frame to frame.
Because each frame is optimised sequentially from the previous one for seconds to minutes ( Tabs. S29 and S30 ), per-frame optimisation cannot reach real-time live streaming.
Sparse-camera 4C4D [ 97 ] and SparseCam4D [ 55 ] instead optimise a whole sequence offline using future frames.
blocks.zh:
3DGStream [65] 列车每帧变换缓存,而HiCoM [16] 和QUEEN [17] 以分级运动和分级剩余来加速每帧优化;ReCon-GS [15] 调整一个运动分级,ComGS [3] 更新的只是运动敏感键点,而iFVC [67] entropy-code a binary变换缓存.
即时高斯流 [83] 以通俗的网络预测运动,但仍能精炼出密钥帧,MORGS [34] 以光学流度在密钥视图上规范出每名高斯流运动,4DGC [23] 选择运动网格进行速率和扭曲,而StrewSTGS [31] 将犬科属性编码为图像,将时间特征编码为视频.
V 3 [75],VideoRF [74],和TeTriRF [78] 将属性或特征装入2D地图,用于视频解码器,而RRF [73] 代码剩余发光场.
HiFi4G [27]和DualGS [26]等以人为中心的系统跟踪一个表演者并压缩由此而来的4D高斯人,SharpTimeGS [41] 调制高斯人的寿命,而NeuS2 [77] 从帧到帧微调一个散列编码的表面.
由于每帧从前一帧相继优化为一秒到一分(Tabs. S29和S30),因此每帧优化无法达到实时活流.
Sparse-camera 4C4D [97] and SparseCam4D [55] 取而代之的是,利用未来框架优化了整个下线序列.

blocks.en:
PointSplat [ 21 ] regresses 3D Gaussians around a coarse point proxy with a Point-Image Transformer in a single pass, which we retain frozen as our reconstructor.
GPS-Gaussian [ 93 , 96 , 2 ] regresses pixel-wise Gaussian maps from adjacent view pairs in real time, and HiReFF [ 28 ] regresses Gaussians from four uncalibrated views.
Concurrent Tele360 [ 70 ] reconstructs Gaussian maps from four to six unposed cameras at over 25 FPS on one GPU and streams the output Gaussians as 2D maps in an H.265 video [ 75 , 85 ] , losing roughly 2 dB to video compression and flickering under rapid motion. LiveGS [ 6 ] brings live free-viewpoint video to mobile devices.
General 3DGS compression methods such as SPZ [ 51 ] , pruning and entropy-coding pipelines [ 14 , 49 , 4 , 79 ] , 2D video-codec grids [ 47 , 85 ] , and training-free or feed-forward compressors [ 63 , 7 , 91 ] all operate after the Gaussian head has expanded tokens into non-linear attributes.
blocks.zh:
PointSplatz [21] 3D高斯人围绕一个粗糙的点代用,在一行一行中有一个Point-Image Transformer,我们保留了它作为我们的重建者.
GPS-高斯文 [93, 96, 2] 实时从相邻的视图对反射出像素-睿智高斯文地图,而HIREFF [28] 则从四个未校正的视图回射出高斯文.
同步Tele360 [70] 重建 Gaussian地图从4到6个未安装相机,位于一个GPU上的超过25个FPS并流出高斯人作为H.265视频中的2D地图[75,85],在快速运动下损失了大约2个dB来进行视频压缩并闪烁. LiveGS [6] 为移动设备带来了现场自由取景视频.
General 3DGS压缩方法,如SPZ [51],穿行和 en-编码管 [14,49,4,79],2D视频-编码网格 [47,85],以及训练无线或feed-forward压缩机 [63,7,91] 都运行于高斯人头被扩展为非线性属性后.

blocks.en:
Split computing executes early network layers on one device and transmits intermediate activations to another [ 30 , 9 , 11 , 46 ] .
GIFStream [ 36 ] compresses temporal feature streams of a 4D representation with learned networks.
CodecSplat [ 87 ] and FeCoSplat [ 39 ] train entropy codecs for intermediate features of a static-scene feed-forward model, and concurrent MFGS [ 10 ] codes multi-view static-scene features before Gaussian prediction.
GS-SCNet [ 84 ] jointly trains a stereo image codec with a two-view Gaussian predictor at 19.2 FPS on an A100, and Feat2GS [ 5 ] projects foundation-model features with PCA before readout.
Rather than training a heavy entropy codec for static scenes, HoloSplat splits a frozen multi-view reconstructor before its Gaussian head, pairing server PCA token compression with a fused client feature reconstruction hypernetwork for frame-parallel multi-GPU streaming.
Where FeCoSplat codes sender-side reconstruction feedback as a second bitstream for every scene, HoloSplat amortises session adaptation into one-time client updates at zero per-frame overhead.
blocks.zh:
分解计算执行一个设备上早期的网络层并传递中间活化到另一个[30,9,11,46].
GIFStream [36] 将4D代表器的时间特征流与有学问的网络压缩.
CodecSplate [87]和FeCoSplate [39] 用于静态-场景向导模型的中间特性的列车等编码器,并存的MFGS [10] 在高斯预测之前的多视图静态-场景特性.
GS-SCNet [84]在A100上联合培训了一台立体图像编码器,并配有一台19.2 FPS的双视高斯预测器,Feat2GS [5]在读取前与PCA一起项目了基础-模型功能.
HoloSplat没有为静态场景训练出一个重等效的编码器,而是将一个被冻结的多视图重建器在高斯头之前分拆出来,将服务器 PA 令牌压缩与一个被保险的客户端功能重建超网络配对,用于帧并行多GPU流.
FeCoSplate代码发送方重建反馈作为每个场景的第二个位流,HoloSplate amorties会话调整为一次性客户端更新,每帧间接费用为0.

blocks.en:
Holoportation [ 54 ] , Fusion4D [ 13 ] , DoubleFusion [ 88 ] , and Function4D [ 89 ] capture performers live by fusing depth sensors.
From RGB cameras, Live4D [ 99 ] streams server-fused meshes, Tele-Aloha [ 69 ] renders telepresence views from four cameras, LiveStre4m [ 59 ] renders novel-view video from two unposed streams with frame interpolation, and StreamSplat [ 62 ] updates a static feed-forward reconstruction causally.
Person-specific avatars transmit a compact driving code per frame but require dedicated per-subject capture and days of training [ 44 , 40 , 61 ] .
HoloSplat instead streams pre-head tokens of arbitrary subjects, enabling clients to decode 3D Gaussians and render free-viewpoint video locally.
blocks.zh:
Holoportation [54],Fusion4D [13], DoubleFusion [88],和函数4D [89] 捕获表演者通过引信深度传感器直播.
从 RGB 相机中, Live4D [99] 溪流服务器充电的 meshes, Tele-Aloha [69] 使四相相机的远程存在视图, LiveStre4m [59] 使两条无源相机流出的新视觉视频带有帧插图, StreamSplat [62] 以因果方式更新了静态的给导重建.
人物特异性人每帧传送一个紧凑的驾驶规范,但要求每个主题的专用捕获和训练日[44,40,61].
HoloSplat转而流出任意主题的前头符号,使客户端能够解码出3D高斯人并本地化自由取景点视频.

blocks.en:
Instance-adaptive neural compression fine-tunes a codec per sequence or static scene and transmits weight updates [ 71 , 53 , 29 , 22 ] , while test-time training adapts reconstruction backbones to distribution shift [ 66 , 76 , 45 , 90 , 72 , 98 ] .
Neural session calibration instead keeps the reconstructor and token stream fixed, rapidly fine-tuning the Gaussian head online on warm-up input views and fusing the update at zero per-frame overhead.
blocks.zh:
实例适应性神经压缩对每个序列或静态场景的编码器进行微调并传递重量更新[71,53,29,22],而测试时间训练则将重建主干线适应分配转移[66,76,45,90,72,98].
相反,神经会话校正使重建器和信使流固定下来,在热量输入视图上迅速微调高斯人的头部,并按每帧零起伏的起伏调节更新.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : HoloSplat splits a frozen feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head and streams tokens with a multi-rate codec combining server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. blocks.en: A pre-trained Gaussian head suffers quality loss under new camera parameters and varying capture conditions, even without compression ( Fig. 4 ). blocks.en: 3.4 Real-Time Frame-Parallel Streaming
blocks.zh: 3.4 实时框架-帕拉尔流

blocks.en: Because frames are coded independently, the server parallelises across frames. Each GPU runs three persistent worker processes under CUDA MPS [ 52 ] ; incoming frames are dispatched to the GPU with the fewest outstanding frames, overlapping matting, inference, token pruning, and PCA projection without a global barrier, while one central encoder quantises and Zstd-codes packets. At most 30 in-flight frames bound memory, and a reorder buffer releases packets strictly in capture order.
blocks.zh: 因为帧是独立编码的,所以服务器平行跨帧. 每个GPU在 CUDA MPS [52] 下运行三个持久的工人流程;接入的帧被发送到GPU,其中未完成的帧数最少,交配,推论相重叠,符号推想,以及没有全局障碍的PCA投影,而一个中央编码器四分位数和Zstd-codes包. 最多30个飞行帧绑定内存,一个重排缓冲器严格按照捕获顺序释放出包.

blocks.en: On HiFi4G and ActorsHQ, scored on held-out cameras after calibrating on the first second of eight input views ( Sec. S6 ), plain PCA decoding loses up to 0.76 dB to our uncompressed reconstruction, and the hypernetwork trained on DNA-Rendering narrows this gap to at most 0.13 dB ( Figs. 4 and S37 ). Whereas a 12-parameter colour-affine transform changes PSNR by only +0.076 and +0.119 dB, NSC adds +1.419 and +1.436 dB at Pro, so even Lite beats the uncalibrated, unpruned reconstruction by +1.327 and +1.282 dB; without further updates, NSC still adds +1.19 and +1.69 dB on the final evaluated frames of each sequence.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: HoloSplat meets the three per-frame budgets of live free-viewpoint video by splitting a feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head into a multi-rate token codec with opacity-guided pruning, PCA dimensionality reduction, and lossless anchor coding. Pro transmits 22.8 × \times less data than float32 Gaussians while a fused feature reconstruction hypernetwork and its one-time update recover 80.4% of the compression loss in 22.1 ms on a laptop GPU, NSC fine-tunes the head online during warm-up with a 44.5 kB update, and frame-parallel encoding averages 32.2 FPS on four GPUs.
blocks.zh: HoloSplat满足了现场自由取景点视频的每帧3个预算,在高斯头之前将一个向导重建器分拆成多速率符号编码器,并配有不透明导出,PCA维度降低,无损失锚地编码. Pro传输的数据比浮点32高斯人少22.8×\times,而一个被引信的功能是重建超网络,其一次性更新恢复了笔记本电脑GPU上22.1ms压缩损失的80.4%,NSC在取暖时用44.5kB更新对头进行在线微调,四个GPU上的帧平行编码平均为32.2FPS.

blocks.en: Frames are coded without tracking Gaussian identities, trading temporal correspondence for barrier-free parallelism, random access at every frame, and zero error propagation. Session setup from the first second of capture takes 24 s on four GPUs before going live, at zero per-frame stream or client overhead.
blocks.zh: 框架的编码没有跟踪高斯人的身份,将时间通信交易为无障碍平行主义,在每一个框架随机访问,零出错传播. 从抓取第一秒开始的会话设置需要24 s在4个GPU上才能启动,以每帧流零或客户端起跑.

To isolate why high attribute variance fails to preserve rendering quality ( Sec. 4.3 ), we perturb the kept groups of frame 30 at each split point on four scenes (0012_09, 0345_08, 0536_06, 0811_06; 48 cameras) before 20% client pruning. To a split representation x x , the tokens T T , hidden features H H or the 224 pre-activation attributes A A of each kept group, we add ρ ​ z \sqrt{\rho}\,z , where z z is a fixed Gaussian direction scaled so that ∥ z ∥ 2 = ∑ i , c ( x i ​ c − x ¯ c ) 2 \lVert z\rVert^{2}=\sum_{i,c}(x_{ic}-\bar{x}_{c})^{2} , the energy of x x about its per-channel mean over the kept groups i i . The perturbation thus carries a fraction ρ ∈ { 0.1 % , 1 % , 3 % , 10 % , 30 % } \rho\in\{0.1\%,1\%,3\%,10\%,30\%\} of each representation’s own centred energy. At ρ = 1 % \rho{=}1\% , perturbing T T or H H changes PSNR by less than 0.01 dB. At the same relative perturbation level ρ \rho , perturbing A A drops PSNR by 16.38 dB ( 26.46 → 10.08 26.46\to 10.08 dB), and the MSE between perturbed and uncompressed renders, averaged over cameras and scenes, is 14,446 × 14{,}446\times that of perturbing T T . Coding individual attribute types at ( r , b ) = ( 80 , 6 ) (r,b){=}(80,6) , lossy scales alone drop PSNR to 11.25 dB, against 21.81–24.68 dB when only another attribute type is lossy; keeping only the scales exact while coding the other four types lossily restores 19.75 dB, against 14.03 dB with all types lossy. blocks.en: Table 3 covers all 16 test sequences, frames 30–89. Its ranges span the sequences, kB/frame includes the first frame or our session state, and s/frame is the time per later frame on one RTX 5090. Times are from runs with the same settings, sequences and inputs on frames 0–59. RGB is reduced to 512 and composited on black with the same soft masks as ours, and poses are converted to OpenCV with halved intrinsics. blocks.en: We fixed bugs in the baselines’ public code without changing their optimisation. QUEEN’s bundled rasteriser culls every point closer than 4 m to the camera, which removes much of the body at DNA-Rendering distances; we restored the original 3DGS rule (0.2 m) and retrained HiCoM, which uses the same rasteriser. blocks.en: 4C4D [ 97 ] , like SparseCam4D [ 55 ] , fits one 4D Gaussian model to a whole captured sequence offline. We run it on all 60 frames from the same eight input cameras with its official DyNeRF [ 38 ] configuration of 30,000 steps, starting from the points that its code reconstructs from the input views with MASt3R-based structure from motion [ 35 ] through the MAtCha codebase [ 20 ] , and render and score its final checkpoint like the streaming runs. Its kB/frame counts the float32 parameters of its 0.4–3.6 M Gaussians over 60 frames, and its s/frame divides the whole fit, without initialisation, by 60. Pro and Ultra beat it on every sequence in PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and bytes ( Tab. S16 ), Ultra by 1.70 dB on average. Lite beats it in LPIPS on all 16 sequences and by 1.27 dB PSNR on average. Figure S10 shows every eight-view method on the view of Fig. 6 .

blocks.en: Table S42 separates plain PCA decoding, the pretrained generic hypernetwork and its one-time hypernetwork update across all three tiers on DNA-Rendering. The generic weights alone recover 31.9/38.7/24.1% of the coding loss at Lite/Pro/Ultra, and the hypernetwork update raises this to 66.7/80.4/68.5%, adding +0.296/+0.193/+0.098 dB even with NSC fitted on each decoder. Controlled ablations on the 16 test scenes support both spatial context and head-metric supervision. Adding the 8-nearest-neighbour context improves PSNR by +0.107/+0.024 dB at Lite/Pro, and randomly permuting neighbour correspondence erases that gain (0.109/0.019 dB below spatial neighbours). Supervising in the head metric W ⊤ ​ W W^{\top}W explains 2.0/2.6 percentage points more head-space residual energy than unweighted token MSE and improves LPIPS by 0.0024/0.0015. The generic hypernetwork trains for 30,000 steps with AdamW at peak learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} (1000 warm-up steps, cosine decay to 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0.01) on batches of 4096 tokens from four scenes, across ten rank and bit-depth settings on 160 training scenes and validated on three held-out actors. The hypernetwork update trains 1000 steps at learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} on frames 0–29 in 2.5–4.2 s per tier on one RTX 5090. In FP16 on the laptop, the hypernetwork preserves the exact FP32 selection of the 20% pruned Gaussians across all 1,488 decoded frames and changes the recovered share of the coding loss by at most 8 × 10 − 6 8\times 10^{-6} .

blocks.en: BiRefNet Lite is fine-tuned at 512 from the official Lite checkpoint on mask-annotated DNA-Rendering data and runs with backbone CUDA graphs at batch size four. Alpha is quantised to 8 bits and multiplied by the area-averaged valid region before reconstruction. Three producer processes per GPU share it through a private CUDA MPS context, and every multi-GPU server uses this setting. Frames are replayed from memory, already undistorted. Steady throughput counts source frames 36–131 as 96 / ( t 131 − t 35 ) 96/(t_{131}-t_{35}) , where t t is the time a packet is ready, taking the best of three runs per scene and averaging over scenes. Throughput does not depend on the tier: matting and reconstruction dominate each frame, and rank-48 (Pro) and rank-80 coding run at a 1.002 throughput ratio on the same GPUs and scenes. Client decoding, the hypernetwork, the head and pruning are timed from a packet in memory to the Gaussians passed to the renderer, on the real packets of 3 test sequences (5,628 token groups per Pro packet on average), with the hypernetwork in FP16 and the head in BF16. Medians over all timed passes are 21.7/22.1/22.8 ms at Lite/Pro/Ultra on the laptop RTX 3050 Ti with a fused Triton 8-nearest-neighbour kernel (0.76/5.55/15.80 ms for the median Pro frame), and 3.9 ms at Pro on an RTX 5090 with the Torch voxel search selected at startup.

Alpha被量化为8比特并被重建前的地区平均有效区域乘以. 每个GPU有三个制作流程通过一个私人的CUDA MPS上下文来分享,每个多GPU服务器都使用这个设置. 框架是从内存中重放的, 已经无法分解 。 稳定的吞吐量计算出源帧 36–131 为96 / (t 131–t 35) 96/ (t_{131}-t_{35}),其中tt是一包准备好的时间,每个场景最多取出3个跑道,并在场景上平均取出. 吞吐量不取决于分级:相配与重建主导了每个相框,而同为GPU和场景的等分-48(Pro)和等分-80的相接编码以1.002的吞吐率运行. 客户端解码,超网络,头部和出行时间从一个包作为内存被传递给高斯人到渲染器,在3个测试序列(平均每个Pro包5,628个令牌组)的真实包上进行定时,FP16中的超网络和头部为BF16. 所有时间出入证的中位数为21.7/22.1/22.8毫秒,使用笔记本电脑RTX 3050。 Ti有被熔化的Triton 8-相邻-相邻内核(中位Pro框架为0.76/5.55/15.80 ms),而由RTX 5090在Pro上进行3.9 ms,启动时选择了火炬活塞搜索.

blocks.en: In 64-second (1,920-frame) live broadcasts at 30 FPS after a 30-frame warm-up, five RTX 5090 GPUs stream Pro packets over Wi-Fi to the laptop RTX 3050 Ti with zero drift. End-to-end latency from capture to rendered frame averages 204–304 ms across the three sequences: 171–261 ms from capture to transmission on the server, 10–14 ms Wi-Fi transfer, 21–33 ms client decoding to Gaussians and 1.8–2.0 ms gsplat [ 86 ] rasterisation. Replacing BiRefNet Lite with the video matting network RVM [ 43 ] and refitting the session state on its mattes lowers Pro’s PSNR on all 16 test sequences, by 1.84 dB on average.
blocks.zh: 64秒(1,920-frame)在30帧热身后在30个FPS进行直播,5个RTX 5090 GPU流 Pro包在Wi-Fi上向笔记本电脑RTX 3050 Ti进行零漂移. 从捕捉到被制成帧的端到端的纬度平均为204–304 ms,跨越了三个序列:从捕捉到服务器上传输的171–261 ms,10–14 ms Wi-Fi传输,21–33 ms客户端解码给高斯人,1.8–2.0 ms gsplat [86]光栅化. 以视频编组网络 RVM [43] 替换 Bir RefNet 的语句, 并重排会话状态于其垫下层 Pro的PSNR在所有16个测试序列上,平均为1.84分贝.

blocks.en: We build on PointSplat [ 21 ] because it is a feed-forward reconstructor designed for multi-view human capture whose per-token Gaussian head gives a natural split point. Its Point-Image Transformer fuses all input views into one shared token set around a coarse point proxy of the performer, each token driving 16 Gaussian slots, so each spatial token is coded once regardless of how many views are fused, unlike pixel-aligned reconstructors that emit a Gaussian map for every input view. At eight views it also leads the feed-forward reconstructors of Tabs. S32 and S43 with 26.17 dB, against 23.14 dB for CodecSplat ( Tab. S32 ) and 18.38–20.47 dB for GPS-Gaussian, DA3 and WorldMirror 2.0.
blocks.zh: 我们建在PointSplat[21]上,因为它是用于多景人类捕捉的饲料向前进的重建器,而平地高斯人的头部给出了一个自然分点. 它的"点-图像变形器"将所有输入视图连接到一个围绕表演者的粗点代理的共享符号集中,每个符号会驱动16个高斯槽,所以无论有多少个视图被接通,每个空间符号都会被编码一次,这与向每个输入视图发送高斯图的像素相通重建器不同. 在8个观点下,它还带领了Tabs. S32和S43的向导重建器以26.17分贝,而CodecSplat(Tab. S32)的为23.14分贝,GPS-Gousisan、DA3和WorldMirror 2.0的为18.38-20.47分贝。

blocks.en: Offline replay of the real packets shows four streaming properties of stateless coding. (i) A viewer joining at frame 30, 60 or 89 downloads a constant 1.05–1.06 MB at Pro (0.84 MB session state plus one packet). Stateful streams accumulate every prior update, reaching 11.7/251.5/483.3 MB for 3DGStream, 22.9/114.4/204.0 MB for HiCoM and 127.8/1710.6/3237.8 MB for QUEEN-l across the 16 scenes. (ii) Losing frame 45 on 0012_09 affects only that frame for Pro, which recovers bit-exact rendering at frame 46. 3DGStream’s relative neural transformation cache propagates the error across all 25 subsequent frames (2.94 dB below its clean stream at frame 70). (iii) With the three merged per-tier decoders resident on the client (137 MB total), switching tiers every 10 frames or randomly per frame over frames 30–89 of 0012_09 and 0022_10 decodes Gaussians bit-identical to each tier’s fixed stream: an element-wise comparison of all decoded means, scales, rotations, opacities and colours finds no differing frame and a maximum absolute difference of 0, and the rendered PSNR and LPIPS of the 10-frame schedule equal those of the fixed streams exactly. (iv) In trace-driven 60 s FIFO link simulations at 30 FPS with a 200 ms deadline (step, square-wave and random-walk bandwidths), causal per-frame tier adaptation reduces the share of frames missing the deadline from 74.9% to 5.0% on the step trace. Clearing queued unsent frames once the oldest unsent frame exceeds the deadline and sending the latest frame lowers the share of skipped or late frames to 0.85% (0.67% skipped, 29.8 FPS delivered). All three per-sequence baselines miss 100% of deadlines even at a constant 100 Mbit/s.

(一)一个在框架30、60或89上加入的查看器在Pro上下载一个常数1.05-1.06 MB(0.84 MB会话状态加一包)。 状态流会累积每次之前的更新,3DGStream的MB达到11.7/251.5/483.3,HiCoM的MB达到22.9/114.4/204.0,而QUEEN-1的MB达到127.8/1710.6/3237.8,跨越了16个场景. (三)由于客户端的每个层次的三套合并解码器(137 MB总计),每10个帧或每帧随机切换一级,超过30-89 0012_09和0022_10帧,解码高斯比特-等同于每个层次的固定流:从元素角度比较所有解码手段,尺度,旋转,不透明和颜色,发现没有不同的帧和最大绝对相差为0;使10帧时间表的PSNR和LPIPS完全等于固定流. (四)在30个FPS的微量驱动的60 s FIFO链接模拟中,有200 ms的最后期限(步道,平相波和随机行走带宽),每帧分级的因果适应将相框在步道跟踪上缺失的比例从74.9%降至5.0%. 一旦最古老的未发送帧超过最后期限并发送最新帧将跳出或后发帧的份额降低到0.85%(0.67%跳出,29.8 FPS已交付),则清除队列未发送帧。 每个序列的所有三个基线都错过了100%的最后期限,即使是在恒定100 Mbit/s.

General-purpose reconstructors trained on scenes or other capture rigs lose the performer’s detail at eight views ( Tab. S43 ) and blur, ghost or fracture the face and limbs ( Fig. S13 ): the strongest of the three reconstructors added in Tab. S43 , WorldMirror 2.0, reaches 20.47 dB, 6.37 dB below our lightest tier at 22.7 × \times the bytes of Pro. We run the released models of three further feed-forward reconstructors on the eight input views, soft masks and scoring of Tab. S4 : Depth Anything 3 [ 42 ] with its Gaussian head, WorldMirror 2.0 [ 68 ] and GPS-Gaussian [ 93 ] . DA3 and WorldMirror 2.0 receive the calibrated cameras in their own conventions and are aligned to the capture frame through the eight input cameras; WorldMirror 2.0 unprojects its predicted depth with these cameras through its released gsdepth+gtcamera path. GPS-Gaussian forms disjoint stereo pairs from the eight input cameras by calibrated geometry, rectifies them at its native 1024 2 1024^{2} resolution with the principal points placing a reference point of the calibrated optical axes at zero disparity, and merges their Gaussians. As for CodecSplat, DA3 and WorldMirror 2.0 run on masked and unmasked inputs and report the variant with the higher scene-averaged PSNR, and GPS-Gaussian takes masked inputs as in its release. Every reconstructor keeps the Gaussians inside the input alpha.
